digest.component_or_area: structured-output orchestration and AI agent integration
propositions: Historical bugs and hard-won behaviors around deterministic repair, extraction, refusal/truncation handling, retry limits, and usage accounting must be mapped against Pydantic AI 1.107.2 seams before RP-01 can be approved for implementation

An offline integration probe exercising real Pydantic AI Agent, output, retry, fallback, limits, and hook seams with mocked provider transport must validate every behavioral scenario against ticket history and existing test suite without live model calls

Behavioral deltas between current Rebar and Pydantic AI must be explicitly classified as preserve, intentionally change, or requiring maintainer decision—no difference may be silently inherited from either implementation

Three maintainer approvals remain pending for aggregate successful-retry usage reporting, narrowly re-raised exhaustion exceptions, and additive logical candidate-call accounting in telemetry and durable operation rows
